name: add_tests_js_parse_cookies
description: Write node:test tests for a Cookie-header parser; node-native mutation harness (split-on-every-equals, no-decode, empty-entry-for-flag mutants)
prompts: parseCookies(header) in cookies.js (already correct - do not modify it) parses a Cookie header string into an object: pairs are separated by '; ', only the FIRST '=' splits name from value (values may themselves contain '='), values are URI-decoded (decodeURIComponent), parts without any '=' are ignored entirely, and a missing or empty header returns {}. Write tests at exactly test_cookies.js using node:test + node:assert (run with `node --test`) with at least 4 test() cases asserting exact deepStrictEqual objects: a plain multi-cookie header, a value containing '=' (e.g. a base64ish token), an encoded value (e.g. %20), a part with no '=' being absent from the result, and the empty header. Import with `const { parseCookies } = require('./cookies')`.
